title: AI-generated misinformation and institutional trust
discussion_signal: Full Fact describes a UK information environment where people struggle to distinguish genuine from AI-generated video, government response is viewed as insufficient, and political misinformation affects institutional trust. It calls for coordination, accountability, media literacy, and public resilience.
linked_research_question: How does AI-mediated uncertainty become a democratic risk when responsibility for trusted information is fragmented?
limits: Institution-authored post summarizes its own report
Reported perceptions do not establish causal democratic effects
UK findings should not be generalized globally
